name: ModelVariant149_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant149_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (five spinning orbs gather on one slot part, fly to points in front of the other slot, burst into rings of light with a spark and flash the screen); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request modulo 100, seeds the orb targets, packs ten texture images and prints the work size, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 before the first burst, 4 as each of the first four orbs bursts, 1 when the fifth does and 2 once the last ring ends; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-166 and 296 images build it without the work-size printf and with a 256-line flash, so their data names bind 0x24 lower. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
